articles.summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, today announced that it has commenced commercial production of Airedale® chillers at a new purpose-built advanced manufacturing facility in Grand Prairie, Texas. The 682,000-square-foot facility is dedicated to manufacturing state-of-the-art 2MW and 3MW chillers with free cooling for the data center market, directly supporting the rapidly expanding infrastructure needs of the world's leading hyperscale cloud providers, colocation operators, and high-density AI computing environments. "The launch of our Grand Prairie facility is an important milestone in the plan we announced last year to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity for Airedale cooling technologies," said Neil D. Brinker, President and CEO. articles.title: Production of Airedale® Chillers for Data Center Customers Begins at New Texas Facility

Effective November 2, Michael Mahan has been appointed President, Data Centers segment. Concurrently, David Furlong is promoted to President, Commercial HVAC (CHVAC), effective November 15.
